worker_judgment_notes: Uses the official City of Raleigh Open Data ArcGIS feature service for Raleigh Police Incidents (NIBRS), a point incident layer with GlobalID/OBJECTID identity, reported_date/reported_year, crime_category/crime_code/crime_description/crime_type, and ArcGIS point geometry. The repo jurisdiction was resolved from state/controls/jurisdiction_controls_2024.parquet as 37:municipal:place:3755000 with state_fips 37. Bounds are the local TIGER 2020 Raleigh place envelope (raw approximately lon -78.818556 to -78.470789, lat 35.70825 to 35.970784) rounded/expanded so the runner does not prematurely drop edge or geocoding-noise records before municipal block-group spatial join. ArcGIS JSON exposes reported_date as epoch milliseconds, so the select projects CAST(reported_date AS VARCHAR(30)) AS reported_date_text for the generic runner while retaining the raw date field. GlobalID is used as the stable row id and OBJECTID only for deterministic ordering. This is a share-lane incident contract only; raw feed counts should not be treated as Raleigh annual totals. Offense mapping is code-restricted: murder excludes justifiable homicide code 13; rape includes only forcible rape/sodomy/object codes 17A/17B/17C and excludes fondling, incest, statutory rape, indecent exposure, and peeping; aggravated assault includes aggravated assault and aggravated child-abuse codes 25G/25M while excluding simple assault/intimidation; burglary, larceny, robbery, and motor-vehicle theft are limited to their direct Raleigh/NIBRS category-code pairs. The 2024 narrowed API pull had some rows without public point geometry, so geography completeness should be evaluated from the runner output, not source row counts.
